return UM.Build:Card()
:DuringCombat(
"During combat: This card's value is +1 for each other VOYAGE card in your discard pile.",
UM.Effects:ModCombatCardValue(
UM.Player:EffectOwner(),
UM.Number:Count(
UM.Select:CardsInDiscardPile(UM.Player:EffectOwner())
:WithLabel("voyage")
:Build()
),
1, true
)
)
:AfterCombat(
"After combat: You may move Sinbad up to 2 spaces.",
UM.Effects:Optional(
'Execute effect?',
UM.Effects:MoveFighters(
UM.Select:Fighters()
:Named("Sinbad")
:Build(),
UM.Number:UpTo(2),
false
)
)
)
:Build()
end

text:

After combat: Deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter.
script:
